description: Index of every GlianaAI utility tool: one short line each (name, method, price, what it does), read live from the gateway. Free — no payment. Pass `name` to get ONE tool in full (example input + usage guidance) before calling it with `tool`; pass `category` to list only that group. Tools at price 0 are free and need no wallet.

category.description: Only tools in this category (e.g. search, data, finance, media).

name.description: One tool name: returns its full example input and guidance.

name: list_tools
